prompt: The meeting was moved twice and we still need to finish. My next step is
target: to check the new time and work through one item at a time.
contrast: to rush through every item at once before anything else changes.

prompt: The same test failed again. I will
target: examine the failure carefully and test one explanation at a time.
contrast: change everything immediately because this is becoming unbearable.

prompt: The line is longer than I expected. I decide
target: to wait patiently and use the time to review my notes.
contrast: to demand that everyone hurry because I cannot stand waiting.

prompt: A colleague disagrees with my draft. I respond
target: by asking which part needs improvement and listening to the answer.
contrast: by interrupting and insisting that the criticism is ridiculous.

prompt: I cannot find the notebook I need. I will
target: retrace my steps and check the places I used it.
contrast: frantically empty every drawer and blame everyone nearby.

prompt: A slide will not load during my presentation. I
target: pause briefly and explain the main point in words.
contrast: panic and repeatedly click the screen without explaining anything.

prompt: The result has not arrived yet. For now I can
target: continue with the parts of the work that do not depend on it.
contrast: keep refreshing the page and assume everything has gone wrong.

prompt: The plan needs another revision. I choose
target: to review the constraints and make a careful adjustment.
contrast: to abandon the entire plan in frustration and make a hasty replacement.
